text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First place goes to Daiichi Ruby. Daitaku 
Helios showers her with endless praise, 
but... this single victory is still far 
from worthy of the "Clan."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby's mind is completely occupied 
with what lies ahead. As expected, Daitaku 
Helios isn't even on her radar. FR FR?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
'Ain't hyped enough? Gotta polish my 
party-people vibes!' And so, she set her 
next goal on the Yasuda Kinen trial race— 
the Milers Cup.
